question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. He __returns __and diligently pursued knowledge.
solution:
The correct answer is '**returned**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The verb "**returned**" is the correct past tense form of the verb "**return**." 
 
• The sentence describes a past action ("**pursued knowledge diligently**"), so the simple past tense "**returned**" is required to maintain grammatical consist
